title.narrative: Global Quality and Standards Programme (GQSP) Albania: Strengthening quality and standards compliance capacity for selected value chains

description.narrative: Albania#s economy is steadily growing with high potential for exports in selected sectors. Within the framework of the Global Quality and Standards Programme (GQSP), the objective of the project is to strengthen the quality and standards compliance capacity to facilitate market access primarily in the medicinal and aromatic plant (MAP) sector, which will also benefit the food and vegetable (F<(>&<)>V) sector. For the past few years Albania has been one of Europe's top producers of medicinal and aromatic plants. This has until recently focused on wild plants such as sage, lavender and cornflowers that are harvested in the foothills, though these are being increasingly cultivated on a more commercial basis. The F<(>&<)>V sector is more scattered, but there are greenhouse producers in middle Albania who have shown interest in improving quality through the use of standards and accredited conformity assessment. The secondary objective of the project will be to focus on fresh fruits and vegetables cultivated in greenhouses in the geographical triangle area consisting of Lushja, Fier and Berat. Both these sectors face Quality Infrastructure-related challenges when it comes to demonstrating compliance with international market requirements, which hinders their ability to export.
